title: Larval Feeding
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rw7d7hn
materials: Larvae were allowed to feed for 60 min

steps.title: Raise Larvae
steps.instruction: Raise both mitotypes on a 1:16 P:C diet.

steps.title: Prepare Dye Labeled Food
steps.instruction: Produce dye labeled food by combining 72 ml of food with 8 ml FD&C blue 1 dye (0.5% w/v) while the food is maintained at 60° C.

steps.title: Feed Larvae
steps.instruction: Place 50 second instar larvae from each mitotype onto the dye labeled food.

steps.title: Collect and Analyze Larvae
steps.instruction: Collect larvae with dye visible in their gut, homogenize them, and record the absorbance at 630 nm.

substeps.instruction: Collect 48 larvae from each mitotype with dye visible in the gut
